title: Neo4j Devcontainer Setup
description: Make Neo4j run zero-touch in the devcontainer and expose Bolt/HTTP so native Neo4j Desktop can connect remotely to the devcontainer.
summary: Implemented a lean Neo4j devcontainer setup with a dedicated Neo4j Compose service publishing localhost Bolt/HTTP ports directly, explicit devcontainer port forwarding for Codespaces, shared Neo4j env values for devcontainer and plain Compose runs, a single default Neo4j MCP server, and updated docs/lifecycle scripts. Validated Docker Compose config, JSON formatting, Neo4j health, host Bolt/HTTP reachability, cypher-shell query execution, workspace-container-to-Neo4j connectivity, and mcp-neo4j-cypher startup.
